priority_rule: Prefer missing integration/state authority that prevents safe use of already-built craft intelligence; do not add dimensions merely because research mentions them.

packets.title: Calibrated Finding -> Revision-Opportunity Admission
packets.why_now: STEP-007 is closed and STEP-H requires ADMIT opportunities. Without this bridge, strong diagnostics cannot safely feed revision generation.
requirements: correlated specialist findings are evidence, not votes
rank by calibrated impact/confidence/purpose relevance/edit-budget fit under preservation/voice/collateral risk
at most three ADMIT by default
never generate revision text or mutate manuscript
acceptance: repeated correlated evidence cannot inflate confidence/priority
ambivalent evidence cannot be forced to ADMIT
output explicitly reports no revision text/manuscript mutation/universal score

packets.title: Canonical Story/Discourse Time + Entity/Event/Causal State Graph
packets.why_now: This consolidates BIGAP-001/BIGAP-002 and is independently reinforced by current narratology, STORYTELLER, DOME, Lost in Stories and LitVISTA.
requirements: story time, discourse time and narrating-time fields where applicable
incremental invalidation when source spans change
no forced chronological normalization of intentionally non-linear narrative
candidate_tests: flashback/flashforward without false chronology repair
same event narrated twice with different discourse placement
duration compression vs scene expansion
middle-book factual/temporal contradiction
character knows event only after exposure
ambiguous chronology preserved as alternatives
editing one source span invalidates only dependent graph claims
packets.a01_value: Later suitable for large whole-book graph extraction/regression campaigns once a registered exact-subject wrapper exists; do not dispatch independently.

packets.title: Global Narrative Function/Anchor/Arc Orchestration
packets.why_now: LitVISTA 2026 identifies integrated function+structure and anchor localization as frontier weaknesses; current AGLO arc bands are useful aggregate slices but not durable functional objects.
requirements: macro/meso/micro views over one shared authority
intentional nonconformity support; no universal plot template
candidate_tests: setup removed -> payoff becomes unsupported
payoff delayed across chapters remains linked
motif recurrence changes function rather than mere count
arc can plateau intentionally without defect label
ending resolves selected open questions while preserving intended ambiguity
global view changes when event anchor changes

packets.title: Creative-Judge Stability, Bias and Abstention Hardening
packets.why_now: LitBench plus 2025-2026 judge research shows generic LLM literary judgments are not reliable enough to function as single-pass authority.
requirements: score-range perturbation checks or prefer pairwise/ordinal outputs
machine metrics may corroborate narrow dimensions but cannot become universal prose quality
candidate_tests: same pair repeated multiple times
original/candidate order swap
same semantic content with uncertainty marker variants
same rhetorical craft with opposing worldview claims
generator identity hidden vs revealed
intentional creative deviation that routine-language judges penalize

packets.title: Repeated-Assistance Voice Identity / Diversity Drift Defense
packets.why_now: Nature Human Behaviour 2026 directly validates homogenization and identity drift under AI assistance; the repository already has the right defense architecture but can add longitudinal evidence.
requirements: project/book/POV baseline-relative lexical and construction distributions
identity-bearing marker drift without inferring sensitive traits
candidate_tests: ten safe micro-edits cannot collapse lexical/cadence diversity beyond project threshold
distinct dialogue speakers remain separable
protected irregularities survive repeated candidate selection
semantic preservation alone cannot override style-identity drift

packets.title: Narrator/Focalizer/Epistemic Privilege State
packets.why_now: Narratology treats perspective as multidimensional and relational; the current hard POV knowledge gate needs a richer durable state authority to operate across long spans.
requirements: perception vs knowledge vs belief vs ideology vs language/register
uncertainty instead of forced focalizer assignment

packets.title: Figurative-Language Function vs Surface-Novelty Fixtures
packets.why_now: Current metaphor research warns that LLM performance may reflect surface cues rather than real contextual interpretation.
requirements: evaluate imagery against passage purpose and motif system
avoid rewarding novelty for novelty's sake

packets.title: Real Author/Reader/Editor Calibration Protocol
packets.why_now: Automatic creative judgments remain meaningfully misaligned with human/professional judgments.
requirements: retain disagreement distributions rather than force consensus
separate author intent from reader preference from editor craft judgment

stop_condition_for_research: Stop broad prose-capability discovery after this pass unless a new implementation boundary exposes a named unknown or materially newer research changes a requirement. Immediate value now comes from implementing and qualifying STEP-008, then designing the canonical narrative-state/orchestration layer.
